purpose: Evidence-driven tuning hints for isolated specialist editing. Human review is required before changes are promoted to main.

search-replace-no-exact-match.promptHint: Use the target map's exact source context and make the smallest patch against the named symbol. If an anchor differs, re-read the current target context and adapt rather than guessing.

no-product-change.promptHint: Materialize one minimal owned-file change that directly satisfies one acceptance criterion; do not return prose.

infrastructure.promptHint: Do not change code strategy for infrastructure failures; preserve the candidate and classify the infrastructure issue.

observations.observation: 17 isolated research lanes completed independently while the production dispatcher failed. Research failures remained contained and did not alter production source.
Fast attempt did not satisfy the benchmark, but escalation to the deeper path produced a passing materialized change.
observations.implication: Retain fast/deep escalation as a candidate research pattern; benchmark the fast path separately before promoting.

observations.observation: Deterministic control produced the target change cleanly without an LLM.
observations.implication: Keep deterministic controls as a baseline for measuring whether LLM strategies add value.

observations.observation: Model-only challenger and dependency-planning lanes completed as evidence-only planning trials with no production edits.
observations.implication: Useful for generating hypotheses/plans, but require a separate falsifiable execution trial before promotion.

observations.observation: Several adapter/edit strategies failed almost immediately (roughly 48-88ms), indicating invocation/adapter failure rather than a meaningful coding benchmark.
observations.implication: Classify sub-100ms zero-diff failures as adapter/invocation evidence and repair the harness before comparing model quality.

observations.observation: Long-running trials reached the ~190s failure boundary without materializing a passing change.
observations.implication: Treat these as timeout/controller evidence; reduce wasted model time or add explicit bounded fallback/recovery before rerunning.

observations.observation: Evolution successfully fed the hypothesis about distinguishing Aider controller non-materialization from clean specialist success into the isolated trial, but the trial failed to materialize a change.
observations.implication: Keep the hypothesis in the learning set and test the measurement directly rather than treating the failed trial as a product conclusion.
